The initial energy comes from the phosphagen (ATP-PCr) system: ATP already stored in the muscle is used first, and it is then rapidly resynthesized from phosphocreatine. This anaerobic, non-lactic pathway supplies the energy for efforts of only a few seconds. The answer depends on whether the question means the first store used (stored ATP) or the main immediate supplier (phosphocreatine), so I've treated them as one system.

CONFIDENCE: 72
